text:
ryan: Heads-up — a few VPC customers ran into 400s from the private ingress when their clients still post to /v1/invoke. Looks like the control-plane enforced the new handshake header (x-rw-api-version) and the edge proxy rejects older shapes.
mona: Ugh. Can you paste a minimal repro? Which part is failing — auth, header parsing, or payload shape?
ryan: Minimal repro is an old SDK that posts with content-type application/json and no x-rw-api-version. Edge proxy tries to validate action="invoke" + model_hint present, fails schema check.
alex: Summary from digging: we tightened the ingress validator to support structured "invoke" v2, but for VPC we expect tenants to manage upgrades. For private customers we still need a graceful compatibility layer.
tereza: Options: 1) add an ingress version-mapper shim that adds x-rw-api-version: 2 when header missing and rewrites a couple fields; 2) keep current strictness and ask tenants to upgrade; 3) route unknown clients to a legacy handler that lives on older runtime.
mona: Mapper shim feels lowest-risk if we make it opt-in per-tenant and short-lived. Telemetry will show client versions and we can nudge.
ryan: Agreed. Implementation sketch: small lua filter in envoy that checks header + body length, then if missing, inject header and translate old "prompt"->"messages" envelope. Should be idempotent.
alex: Note tradeoffs: translation may hide buggy clients and postpone upgrades. Also adds CPU overhead on edge and subtle behavioral differences (we might implicitly canonicalize role tokens).
tereza: Rollout plan: feature-flag per-tenant off by default. Enable for two internal tenants, then three external canaries. Monitor: 4xx rate, median p50/p95 latency at ingress, translation error rate, and quality regression alerts tied to evals.
mona: Telemetry keys: compat.mapper.enabled, compat.mapper.errors, compat.mapper.translations. Add a tag tenant_id.
ryan: Also need an escape hatch: disable by tenant or global. Add a quick toggle in admin console + infra CLI: 
```
infra toggle compat-mapper --tenant=acme --on
```

alex: For safety, the shim should preserve signature of requests for auditing and not mutate non-essential fields. Log original payload hash and modifications.
tereza: Any perf budget numbers? If lua filter adds ~0.5ms median we can absorb it for canaries. If >5ms for 99p, abort.
mona: I'll add the RFC follow-up doc with the schema mappings and expected deprecation timeline (60 days canary, 120 days tenant opt-in, 180 days mandatory or fully removed).
ryan: Ops checklist before enabling for external: automated rollback playbook, alerting for translation failures >0.5% and spike in 4xx, and QA run with synthetic old-client traffic.
tereza: One more: key management — when we translate we must not alter auth headers. If a token audience changed between versions, just pass through.
infra-bot: deploy:compat-mapper v0.1 started to staging at 2025-06-11T18:12:33Z :rocket:
ryan: Nice. After staging validation we'll canary to tenants 101 and 403. I'll own the rollout and postmortem if any. :thumbsup:
mona: Thanks — I'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow to finalize telemetry and the admin toggle UX. :eyes:
